## Overview

Simulate how a combo would route a request from the CLI, using live combo, health and quota data, without sending traffic upstream.

## Quick install

```bash
npm install -g omniroute   # or: npx omniroute
omniroute --version
```

## Subcommands

### `simulate [prompt]`

**Flags:**

- `--file <path>`
- `-m, --model <id>`
- `--combo <name>`
- `--reasoning-effort <level>`
- `--thinking-budget <n>`
- `--explain`

**Example:**

```bash
omniroute simulate [prompt]
```

<!-- skill:custom-start -->

# OmniRoute — CLI Simulate

Requires the `omniroute` CLI. See [CLI entry-point skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute/main/skills/cli-serve/SKILL.md) for install + global flags.

`omniroute simulate` is a dry run: it reads `/api/combos`, `/api/monitoring/health` and
`/api/usage/quota` and shows which providers a request would be routed to, without calling
any upstream.

```bash
omniroute simulate "hello" --combo my-combo --explain
omniroute simulate --file ./request.json -m auto
```
<!-- skill:custom-end -->
